answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The basalt holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
